summary: Provider trust governs the execution channel, independently of model capability and model-level authority.

items.text: Use task-specific capability evidence when selecting a model; an approved provider does not make every model suitable for every task.
Combine provider constraints with the model trust map so both the model and the channel are authorized.
See Agent Fencing for the related use case or counterpoint: The platform owns the durable history; agents receive bounded authority and oversight proportional to trust and risk.
